work.description: Independent, self-directed engineering — building open-source systems and developer tooling under github.com/organic-systems.

Sole data and AI function at a four-person pre-seed, taking a campaign-analytics platform from concept to production. Built an autonomous observe–decide–act agent and an LLM-as-judge evaluation harness that held factual accuracy above 90% before any output reached customers.

Rebuilt a stalled electrophysiology analysis pipeline, cutting runtime 9 times via incremental recompute and avoiding ~$200K in estimated hardware cost. Shipped a fully air-gapped clinical RAG assistant over 500+ biomedical papers.

Re-mapped Segment tracking across 15+ product touchpoints and authored the canonical event spec, improving event-capture reliability 40%. Ran onboarding and retention A/B tests that lifted 30-day retention 22%, and owned the AWS product-data pipeline end to end.

Mapped the mobile onboarding funnel in Mixpanel and SQL to pinpoint drop-off, shipping fixes that lifted feature adoption 28%. Replaced manual weekly reporting with an Airflow-orchestrated pipeline, cutting analyst effort threefold.
